title: Member Labour Discounts and Protection Claim Work by Service Level
content:
# Counter Card: Member Labour Discounts and Protection Claim Work

Kept at the counter for the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service: the discount members of the loyalty programme receive on bench labour at each service level, and which levels admit work carried out under a protection claim.

| Service level | Member discount on bench labour, percent | Work under a protection claim admitted |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Bench Service | 0 | yes |
| Priority Bench Service | 5 | yes |
| Master Jeweler Service | 5 | yes |
| Heritage Restoration Service | 10 | yes |
| Designer Authorized Repair Service | 0 | no |
| Atelier White-Glove Service | 10 | yes |

## Notes

The member discount is a percentage of bench labour and carries 0 percent at Standard Bench Service and at Designer Authorized Repair Service. Work under a protection claim is admitted at every level except Designer Authorized Repair Service.
